name: Novosibirsk Oblast
note: The Novosibirsk regional government's name appears on the lower back of HC Sibir's 2026-27 playing jersey (club match photos, 24-09-2026); the Government of Novosibirsk Oblast is the club's founder per the official site, and KS Online (03-12-2025) documents a 2026 oblast subsidy for the club of up to 1.048 bn RUB via the oblast sports ministry.
